one_liner_zh: 家得寶EPS幾近符合預期，營收年增4.8%顯示房屋裝修需求溫和回穩。
one_liner_en: Home Depot landed near in-line on EPS with 4.8% revenue growth, signaling a modest home-improvement recovery.
beat_or_miss: 符合預期 / EPS僅超預期0.69%，營收年增4.79%顯示需求溫和回穩。
ai_view_zh: 訊號中性偏正：EPS幾近符合預期，營收年增近5%顯示房屋裝修需求在高利率環境下溫和回穩，可視為觸底訊號。短期股價中性，缺乏強催化。中期關鍵在利率走向與房市交投回溫帶動大型裝修專案。追蹤指標：同店銷售（comps）、客單價與來客數、Pro業務成長、毛利率與全年指引，以及房市與利率動向。
ai_view_en: Signal is neutral-to-positive: near-in-line EPS with ~5% revenue growth shows home-improvement demand stabilizing modestly amid high rates, arguably a bottoming signal. Near-term neutral with no strong catalyst. Mid-term the key is the rate path and a housing-turnover recovery reviving large remodeling projects. Track: comparable-store sales, ticket and traffic, Pro-business growth, gross margin and full-year guidance, plus housing and rate trends.
highlights_zh: EPS 3.43美元，與預期3.41美元接近，超預期幅度0.69%
營收417.7億美元，年增4.79%，房屋裝修需求溫和回升
專業承包商（Pro）業務與規模採購維持競爭力
穩定股息與回購支撑股東回報
highlights_en: EPS of $3.43 came in near the $3.41 estimate, a 0.69% beat
Revenue of $41.77B grew 4.79%, with home-improvement demand recovering modestly
Professional (Pro) business and scale purchasing maintain competitiveness
Steady dividends and buybacks support shareholder returns
risks_zh: EPS僅持平，缺乏向上驚喜的催化動能
高利率與房市交投低迷壓抑大型裝修專案需求
消費者支出向必需品傾斜，可選消費承壓
risks_en: EPS merely in line, lacking an upside-surprise catalyst
High rates and a sluggish housing market suppress large remodeling-project demand
Consumer spending tilting to staples pressures discretionary categories
